Tessa / Marissa — quick internal note and suggested reply copy.

Audit period: Covered Type II report on file is for 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 (report dated 2025-10-31). So that aligns with Acme's request.

What we can share (standard practice):
- Bridge letter: Signed, confirms that the Type II report covers the period above and summarizes scope. Sent to prospects immediately.
- Full Type II report: Provided to customers under a mutual NDA/ACL and delivered via encrypted pre-signed S3 link (time-limited) or secure SharePoint link. We require: requestor email, business justification (procurement/vendor review), and a signed mutual NDA when legal requests full report.

Suggested external reply (short):
"Hi Dana — we can provide a signed bridge letter today that confirms coverage for 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30. If you require the full Type II report, we can share an encrypted copy under our NDA and via a time-limited secure link. Please confirm which you prefer and the best contact email for transfer"

Transfer steps (when providing full report):
1) Send purchaser/procurement contact email and attach completed vendor intake form.
2) Execute our standard mutual NDA (we can provide).
3) We will upload a password-protected PDF to an S3 pre-signed URL and share the key via a separate email or a secure vault. Link expires in 7 days.

Attachments to include in final outbound: Bridge_Letter_Redwood_template.docx (populate & sign) and secure-transfer-instructions.txt (one-page). I've attached both to this internal thread for Tessa to send externally.

Internal note: mark the ticket in HubSpot (ACME-3492) and set a 48-hour SLA for delivery after confirmation.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
